text: When Fari and her entourage arrived at the gates of the capital, the palace guards nearly dropped their spears.
The king, seeing Fari's poise and graceful carriage, declared that a royal delegation of noble foreign princesses had arrived.
For days, the newcomers were treated to sumptuous platters of spiced benachin rice, sweet roasted groundnuts, and mangoes dripping with juice.
Fari smiled sweetly, nodding with royal elegance, while her companions giggled behind their veils, nudging each other with knees that still remembered the habit of kicking.
